item.title: Version 0.1.5
item.description:
What's changed

  • Fix sound issues (5303663)
  • Add v0.1.4 to the appcast [skip actions] (d282221)
  • Restore native .help tooltips (38b3739)

Install

Download Streamif-0.1.5-universal.dmg, drag Streamif to Applications, and launch it.

The build is a universal binary, signed with a Developer ID certificate and notarized by Apple.

Requires macOS 14.0 or later. Existing installs update themselves through Sparkle.

Full changelog: https://github.com/nilbuild/streamif/compare/v0.1.4...v0.1.5
